title: [Project Arches] Microsoft Fabric Export Setup
summary: New Microsoft Fabric Export functionality allows Business Central to export data to Microsoft Fabric with setup pages, configuration packages, and platform management capabilities.
key_points: Adds Fabric API pages for exposing configuration and export operations
Introduces configuration package tables and management for Fabric exports
Provides platform setup wizard and management pages for Fabric connections
Includes permission sets for admin, read-only, and activation access
Supports telemetry and privacy notice handling for Fabric integration
